listing.name: Perfect Dark — v64recomp / perfectdark-us-v11 (polaco1782)
listing.summary: Experimental project. CarringtonInstitute screenshot; A complete playthrough has not been confirmed; results from another game do not establish that this one works. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Perfect Dark Nintendo 64 USA v1.1 ROM. Check the required size and SHA-1 in games/perfectdark-us-v11/profile.toml before importing. Keep the original separately. These instructions do not download or run it.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use tools/import_rom.py --profile games/perfectdark-us-v11/profile.toml to normalize your own .z64, .n64 or .v64 ROM. Build the CMake perfectdark-us-v11-release target to produce the native perfectdark-us-v11 player. The default keeps the ROM external; an optional build that embeds it must remain private. This is manual setup from source; Portcove-managed download and completed setup or gameplay checks are not offered.
